desc: Art Attack really drawn, at 120 Hz: three loops steered round the enemies with the stick in a battle (hei_00, battle 4), the cut-outs, the damage and the end of the move. A frame drawn between the game's freed the loop's screen capture and the game's own frame then read it: a crash the moment the first loop closed (0.5.0, any frame rate above 60 or stereo 3D)
